story.mimi.intro.0: MiMi: Phew... I made it! Sorry for flying straight to your house like this.
story.mimi.intro.1: MiMi: Did you pick up a very suspicious piece of torn cardboard? The kind that looks cheap but somehow has magic in it?
story.mimi.intro.2: MiMi: Aha! That is definitely it. ChaCha noticed it immediately too.
story.mimi.intro.3: MiMi: I have something urgent to deal with right now. Meet me at the Wizard’s house between 1 PM and 5 PM.
story.mimi.intro.4: MiMi: Don’t be late! And if he asks... I absolutely did NOT investigate this on my own first.
story.mimi.objective: Meet MiMi at the Wizard’s house from 1:00 PM–5:00 PM.
story.mimi.quest-added: New quest: An Appointment with MiMi
story.mimi.meetup-too-early: MiMi asked you to meet at the Wizard’s house from 1:00 PM–5:00 PM. It is still a little early.
story.meetup.1: MiMi: You actually came! I bet him you wouldn't forget.
story.meetup.4: Wizard: The scrap you carry resonates with this machine and this Binder. Something appears to have chosen you as their user.
story.meetup.5: Wizard: Take the Cardcha Machine and Cardcha Binder. But the machine cannot awaken by itself.
story.meetup.6: Wizard: It needs a creature able to guide magic through its resonance core. ChaCha can serve as that key.
story.chapter1.complete: CARDCHA — CHAPTER 1 COMPLETE! ChaCha will keep traveling with you and activating the machine.
pullanim.title: CARDCHA RITUAL!
pullanim.status.approach: ChaCha is getting the machine ready...
pullanim.status.orb: ChaCha brings out the Cardcha Orb!
story.meetup.7: MiMi: Huh?! ...Fine, fine. You can borrow ChaCha for a while. Take good care of him!
story.meetup.8: ChaCha: Puu! ✦  MiMi: See? He agreed. ChaCha is going to be much more useful to you than you think... you'll understand later.
story.meetup.9: MiMi: Oh, and don’t worry about the scraps stuffed in your bag. Once you receive the Binder, they’ll move into it automatically. I also buy and sell scraps from 11:00 AM–5:00 PM, Monday through Friday. If the weather gets nasty, find me inside the Wizard’s house... merchants are allowed to be afraid of lightning too.
story.machine-unlocked: Received the Cardcha Machine, Cardcha Binder, and ChaCha’s help.
story.first-pull.objective: New quest: use ChaCha to activate the Cardcha Machine and make 1 pull. MiMi bundled {{amount}} Cardboard Scrap with the machine.
story.mystery.0: ???: I’m looking for someone special. Not famous or anything... just unusually hard to recognize.
story.mystery.1: ???: The funny part is, that person probably doesn’t even know I’m looking for them yet.
story.mystery.2: ???: If you happen to find anything strange... ah, never mind. Pretend I didn’t say that.
story.mystery.3: ???: This town is peaceful. Maybe a little too peaceful...
story.mystery.4: ???: You? Hmm... not sure yet. I need to observe a little longer.
story.mystery.villager.1: I don’t think I’ve ever seen her in Pelican Town before...
story.mystery.villager.2: She looks like she is searching for someone.
story.mystery.villager.3: That floating rabbit beside her is unusual too...
mimi.shop.title: MiMi Shop
mimi.shop.quip: MiMi: Normal Scrap? I buy for 100g and sell for 1,000g. Shiny? 1,000g in, 10,000g out. Don't calculate the markup — it causes emotional damage. Quick, I've got places to be!
mimi.shop.status.welcome: MiMi is checking prices at a suspiciously urgent pace.
mimi.shop.status.poor: MiMi: Your wallet has formally objected to this transaction.
mimi.shop.status.empty: MiMi: You don't have that Scrap to sell me.
mimi.shop.status.bought: MiMi: Deal! {{price}}g. Straight into the Binder — no backpack slot wasted.
mimi.shop.status.sold: MiMi: I'll take it for {{price}}g. The markup? Trade secret.
machine.place.home-only: This Cardcha Machine only works inside your main farmhouse. MiMi claims the core is "allergic to outdoor hobbies."
story.mimi.quest-description: MiMi flew all the way to your home to arrange a meeting with her and the Wizard. While the appointment is unresolved, MiMi will not appear in town.
story.mimi.quest-objective: Meet MiMi at the Wizard’s house between 1:00 PM and 5:00 PM.
story.forced-home.1: MiMi: THREE DAYS. I gave you that appointment THREE DAYS ago. Did a monster eat your calendar?!
story.forced-home.2: Wizard: I told her you might simply be... unusually gifted at forgetting things. It seems I underestimated you.
story.forced-home.3: MiMi: I am running enough deadlines to make my broom shed bristles, and you left me waiting until day three. My time is expensive, you know!
story.forced-home.4: Wizard: Enough. If the chosen one will not come to collect what is needed, then we will bring it here ourselves.
story.forced-home.5: MiMi: Here! Cardcha Machine, Cardcha Binder, and ChaCha. Home delivery. No returns. Shipping fee today is... temporarily waived.
story.forced-home.6: Wizard: The scraps you collected will be stored in the Binder. Use this machine carefully; much about what lies behind it remains unclear.
story.forced-home.7: MiMi: And next time, please look at your quest log! I have places to rush to... and money to make.
story.forced-home.8: Wizard: We should leave. What needed to be delivered is now in your hands.
story.forced-home.9: MiMi: Finally! ChaCha, behave yourself. Puu! ✦
portable.machine.name: Portable Cardcha Machine
portable.machine.desc: A pocket-sized Cardcha device. Select it on the toolbar and use it to open the Cardcha Machine almost anywhere.
portable.machine.locked: The portable machine refuses to boot. You still need MiMi and the Wizard to finish setting up Cardcha first.
portable.machine.busy: Not now. Even MiMi agrees opening a gacha machine during an event is a bad idea.
mimi.shop.quip.portable: MiMi: Scrap prices are on the board. Oh, and yes, that little machine is portable. Only 20,000g. Don't make that face — convenience is expensive and I'm in a hurry!
portable.shop.progress: Collection: {{count}}/{{target}} unique cards. Reach {{target}} and MiMi will hand over a portable machine for free.
portable.shop.secret: You can Cardcha whenever you like.
portable.shop.owned: Portable machine acquired. MiMi is trying very hard not to mention the receipt.
portable.shop.status.bought: MiMi: 20,000g received! See? Portable convenience. Beautiful. Profitable. Mostly profitable.
portable.shop.status.gifted: MiMi: Twenty unique cards already?! Fine, take the portable machine. Free. Don't get used to that word around me.
portable.shop.status.owned: MiMi: You already have one. I'm greedy, not irresponsible enough to sell you the same machine twice.
portable.shop.status.poor: MiMi: 20,000g. Come back when your wallet stops making that noise.
portable.shop.status.locked: MiMi: Finish the Cardcha handoff first. I sell questionable technology, not unfinished questionable technology.
portable.machine.ui.title: PORTABLE CARDCHA MACHINE
portable.machine.status.default: ChaCha is linked to the portable machine. Choose a Cardcha pull.
portable.pullanim.title: POCKET CARDCHA!
portable.pullanim.status.approach: ChaCha flies into the portable machine...
portable.pullanim.status.hover: ChaCha lines up with the card slot...
portable.pullanim.status.dive: ChaCha dives in to fetch the card!
portable.pullanim.status.fetch: Got it! ChaCha is pulling the card out...
portable.pullanim.status.present: ChaCha brings the card to you!
mimi.shop.first-post-handoff: MiMi: Now that you have the machine, don't let it collect dust. Keep gathering lots of cards — hit the right milestone and I might have a surprise for you. Whether it's free or not... depends on my mood and my profit margin.

story.meetup.10: ???: Oh, right... I forgot the most important part. I’m MiMi. You can call me that from now on!
story.forced-home.10: ???: One more thing. I’m MiMi. After a doorstep delivery like this, I guess there is no point hiding my name anymore.

card.marked_prey.name: Marked Prey
card.marked_prey.desc: The first monster you hit after 3 seconds out of combat takes extra damage from you for a short time.
card.marked_prey.star.1: First target after 3s out of combat takes +10% damage for 5s.
card.marked_prey.star.2: First target after 3s out of combat takes +13% damage for 5s.
card.marked_prey.star.3: First target after 3s out of combat takes +16% damage for 5s.
card.marked_prey.star.4: First target after 3s out of combat takes +19% damage for 5s.
card.unyielding.name: Unyielding
card.unyielding.desc: A single hit cannot exceed a percentage of your maximum HP. This protection has a cooldown.
card.unyielding.star.1: A single hit cannot exceed 45% maximum HP; 20s cooldown.
card.unyielding.star.2: A single hit cannot exceed 40% maximum HP; 18s cooldown.
card.unyielding.star.3: A single hit cannot exceed 35% maximum HP; 16s cooldown.
card.collectors_instinct.name: Collector's Instinct
card.collectors_instinct.desc: Defeating an Elite/Apex/Boss has an extra chance to grant +1 Cardboard Scrap.
card.berserker_soul.name: Berserker Soul
card.berserker_soul.desc: For every 10% HP missing, gain a small damage bonus up to a hard cap.
card.chain_hunter.star.1: Kill within 5s: +4% damage per stack, max 5.
card.chain_hunter.star.2: Kill within 5s: +5% damage per stack, max 5.
card.chain_hunter.star.3: Kill within 5s: +6% damage per stack, max 5.
card.soul_siphon.name: Soul Siphon
card.soul_siphon.desc: A small portion of damage dealt to monsters is converted into healing, with a healing-per-second cap.
card.soul_siphon.star.1: Convert 1% damage dealt into healing; cap 3 HP/s.
card.soul_siphon.star.2: Convert 1.25% damage dealt into healing; cap 4 HP/s.
card.soul_siphon.star.3: Convert 1.5% damage dealt into healing; cap 5 HP/s.
card.phantom_step.name: Phantom Step
card.phantom_step.desc: While monsters are present, a quick evasive movement when you haven't just taken damage primes bonus crit chance for the next hit; has a cooldown.
card.phantom_step.star.1: Quick evasive movement: next hit +15% crit chance; 8s cooldown.
card.phantom_step.star.2: Quick evasive movement: next hit +20% crit chance; 7s cooldown.
card.phantom_step.star.3: Quick evasive movement: next hit +25% crit chance; 6s cooldown.
card.reapers_mark.name: Reaper's Mark
card.reapers_mark.desc: Repeated hits on the same target apply a Mark. Marked targets take bonus damage until they die or the Mark expires.
card.reapers_mark.star.1: 4 hits on the same target apply Mark: +8% damage for 6s.
card.reapers_mark.star.2: 4 hits on the same target apply Mark: +10% damage for 6s.
card.reapers_mark.star.3: 4 hits on the same target apply Mark: +12% damage for 6s.
card.stoneheart.name: Stoneheart
card.stoneheart.desc: While above 80% HP, take reduced damage. The effect ends below the threshold.
card.last_stand.star.1: Below 25% HP: +3 Defense and +12% damage for 6s.
card.last_stand.star.2: Below 25% HP: +4 Defense and +16% damage for 6s.
card.last_stand.star.3: Below 25% HP: +5 Defense and +20% damage for 6s.
card.war_drum.name: War Drum
card.war_drum.desc: Each kill builds attack-speed stacks. Reaching maximum stacks grants a short burst of bonus damage.
card.war_drum.star.1: On kill: +3% attack speed per stack, max 4; at max, +8% damage for 3s.
card.war_drum.star.2: On kill: +4% attack speed per stack, max 4; at max, +10% damage for 3s.
card.war_drum.star.3: On kill: +5% attack speed per stack, max 4; at max, +12% damage for 3s.
card.treasure_hunter.name: Treasure Hunter
card.treasure_hunter.desc: Defeating an Elite/Apex/Boss has a higher chance to grant +1 Cardboard Scrap.
card.golden_hand.name: Golden Hand
card.golden_hand.desc: Every set number of pulls grants extra Magic Dust without changing rarity rolls.
card.arcane_recycler.name: Arcane Recycler
card.arcane_recycler.desc: Duplicate Rare-or-higher cards refund part of the resources spent on the pull.
card.arcane_recycler.star.1: Duplicate Rare+: refund 5% of pull resources.
card.arcane_recycler.star.2: Duplicate Rare+: refund 7.5% of pull resources.
card.arcane_recycler.star.3: Duplicate Rare+: refund 10% of pull resources.
card.mirror_guard.name: Mirror Guard
card.mirror_guard.desc: After one hit removes at least 25% of max HP, the next incoming hit is heavily reduced if the card is ready.
card.mirror_guard.star.1: Lose ≥25% max HP to one hit: next hit -30% damage; 12s cooldown.
card.mirror_guard.star.2: Lose ≥25% max HP to one hit: next hit -40% damage; 10s cooldown.
card.mirror_guard.star.3: Lose ≥25% max HP to one hit: next hit -50% damage; 8s cooldown.
card.relentless.name: Relentless
card.relentless.desc: Repeatedly hitting the same target builds damage up to a cap; switching targets resets the stacks.
card.relentless.star.1: Same target: +2% damage per hit, max 5; switching targets resets.
card.relentless.star.2: Same target: +2.5% damage per hit, max 6; switching targets resets.
card.relentless.star.3: Same target: +3% damage per hit, max 7; switching targets resets.
card.overclock.name: Overclock
card.overclock.desc: Defeating an Elite or Apex enemy grants a strong attack-speed buff for several seconds.
card.lucky_break.name: Lucky Break
card.lucky_break.desc: After several failed bonus-loot rolls, temporarily gain extra bonus-loot chance until one succeeds.
card.lucky_break.star.1: After 3 failed bonus-loot rolls: +8% chance until success.
card.lucky_break.star.2: After 3 failed bonus-loot rolls: +12% chance until success.
card.lucky_break.star.3: After 3 failed bonus-loot rolls: +16% chance until success.
card.battle_scholar.name: Battle Scholar
card.battle_scholar.desc: Defeating enough different monster types in one day grants a small mixed combat buff.
card.battle_scholar.star.1: Defeat 3 monster types/day: +3% damage, +2% attack speed.
card.battle_scholar.star.2: Defeat 3 monster types/day: +4% damage, +3% attack speed.
card.battle_scholar.star.3: Defeat 3 monster types/day: +5% damage, +4% attack speed, +1 Defense.
card.phoenix_heart.star.1: Once/day: lethal hit leaves 1 HP + 1.0s invulnerability.
card.phoenix_heart.star.2: Once/day: lethal hit leaves 1 HP + 1.5s invulnerability.
card.phoenix_heart.star.3: Once/day: lethal hit leaves 1 HP + 2.0s invulnerability.
card.void_walker.name: Void Walker
card.void_walker.desc: After taking damage, you can enter a short phase state that reduces damage and increases movement speed. Has a long cooldown.
card.void_walker.star.1: After being hit: 15% chance for 1.5s phase, -40% damage, +15% movement speed; 20s cooldown.
card.void_walker.star.2: After being hit: 20% chance for 1.75s phase, -50% damage, +20% movement speed; 18s cooldown.
card.void_walker.star.3: After being hit: 25% chance for 2.0s phase, -60% damage, +25% movement speed; 16s cooldown.
card.soul_eater.name: Soul Eater
card.soul_eater.desc: Kills build Soul. At full Soul, restore HP and gain a short damage buff, then reset Soul.
card.soul_eater.star.1: At 6 kills: restore 10% maximum HP and gain +10% damage for 5s.
card.soul_eater.star.2: At 5 kills: restore 12% maximum HP and gain +12% damage for 5s.
card.soul_eater.star.3: At 4 kills: restore 15% maximum HP and gain +15% damage for 5s.
card.time_breaker.name: Time Breaker
card.time_breaker.desc: A hit Cardcha identifies as crit-like can trigger a large attack-speed burst; has an internal cooldown.
card.time_breaker.star.1: Crit-like hit: 10% chance for +30% attack speed for 3s; 12s cooldown.
card.time_breaker.star.2: Crit-like hit: 12% chance for +35% attack speed for 3s; 10s cooldown.
card.time_breaker.star.3: Crit-like hit: 15% chance for +40% attack speed for 3s; 8s cooldown.
card.titans_grip.name: Titan's Grip
card.titans_grip.desc: Slightly reduces attack speed but greatly increases damage per hit.
card.perfect_hunter.name: Perfect Hunter
card.perfect_hunter.desc: Kills made without taking damage build critical-hit chance stacks. Taking a hit removes the stacks.
card.perfect_hunter.star.1: No-hit kill: +2% crit chance per stack, max 5.
card.perfect_hunter.star.2: No-hit kill: +2.5% crit chance per stack, max 5.
card.perfect_hunter.star.3: No-hit kill: +3% crit chance per stack, max 5.
card.kings_ransom.name: King's Ransom
card.kings_ransom.desc: Apex and Boss enemies gain one guaranteed extra non-exclusive reward roll.
card.kings_ransom.star.2: Guaranteed roll: +20% chance to improve reward quality.
card.kings_ransom.star.3: Guaranteed roll: +35% chance to improve reward quality.
card.cardmaster.name: Cardmaster
card.cardmaster.desc: Every 10 Standard pulls grants Magic Dust; the next Standard pull gets a tiny Rare+ chance boost without bypassing pity/insurance.
card.cardmaster.star.1: Every 10 Standard pulls: +5 Dust; next Standard +1 percentage point Rare+ chance.
card.cardmaster.star.2: Every 10 Standard pulls: +7 Dust; next Standard +1.5 percentage points Rare+ chance.
card.cardmaster.star.3: Every 10 Standard pulls: +10 Dust; next Standard +2 percentage points Rare+ chance.
card.guardian_angel.name: Guardian Angel
card.guardian_angel.desc: When HP falls below a dangerous threshold, gain a large shield once per day.
card.guardian_angel.star.1: Below 20% HP: shield equal to 25% maximum HP, once/day.
card.guardian_angel.star.2: Below 20% HP: shield equal to 35% maximum HP, once/day.
card.guardian_angel.star.3: Below 20% HP: shield equal to 45% maximum HP, once/day.
card.apex_predator.name: Apex Predator
card.apex_predator.desc: Deals extra damage to Elite, Apex, and Boss enemies. Defeating them grants a short combat buff.
card.apex_predator.star.1: +10% damage vs Elite/Apex/Boss; defeating one grants +8% damage for 6s.
card.apex_predator.star.2: +15% damage vs Elite/Apex/Boss; defeating one grants +10% damage for 6s.
card.apex_predator.star.3: +20% damage vs Elite/Apex/Boss; defeating one grants +12% damage for 6s.
card.endless_hunt.name: Endless Hunt
card.endless_hunt.desc: Kills extend the Hunt state. During Hunt, damage and speed increase with stacks up to a hard cap; all stacks reset when Hunt ends.
card.endless_hunt.star.1: Hunt lasts 5s and kills refresh it. +2% damage and +1% speed per stack, max 6.
card.endless_hunt.star.2: Hunt lasts 5s and kills refresh it. +2.5% damage and +1.25% speed per stack, max 7.
card.endless_hunt.star.3: Hunt lasts 5s and kills refresh it. +3% damage and +1.5% speed per stack, max 8.
card.fate_weaver.name: Fate Weaver
card.fate_weaver.desc: Pulls that fail to reach Epic+ build Fate. At the threshold, the next pull is raised by one rarity tier, then Fate resets. Cannot exceed Mythic.
card.fate_weaver.star.1: Each non-Epic+ pull grants 1 Fate; at 12 Fate, next pull gains +1 rarity tier.
card.fate_weaver.star.2: Each non-Epic+ pull grants 1 Fate; threshold reduced to 10 Fate.
card.fate_weaver.star.3: Each non-Epic+ pull grants 1 Fate; threshold reduced to 8 Fate.
card.immortal_echo.name: Immortal Echo
card.immortal_echo.desc: When you would die, enter Echo for several seconds: you cannot heal but can keep fighting. Defeat enough monsters before it ends to revive with a small amount of HP. Very long cooldown.
card.immortal_echo.star.1: On lethal damage: Echo for 5s; defeat 3 monsters to revive at 10% HP; very long cooldown.
card.immortal_echo.star.2: On lethal damage: Echo for 6s; defeat 3 monsters to revive at 15% HP; very long cooldown.
card.immortal_echo.star.3: On lethal damage: Echo for 7s; defeat 3 monsters to revive at 20% HP; very long cooldown.
card.worldbreaker.name: Worldbreaker
card.worldbreaker.desc: Repeated hits on the same Elite, Apex, or Boss build damage stacks up to a cap. When that target dies, it releases a small damaging shockwave around it.
card.worldbreaker.star.1: Same Elite/Apex/Boss: +2% damage per hit, max 10; on death, shockwave deals 15% weapon damage.
card.worldbreaker.star.2: Same Elite/Apex/Boss: +2.5% damage per hit, max 10; on death, shockwave deals 20% weapon damage.
card.worldbreaker.star.3: Same Elite/Apex/Boss: +3% damage per hit, max 10; on death, shockwave deals 25% weapon damage.

config.controller.section.tooltip: Cardcha uses one semantic controller profile across the Binder, machine, and gacha screens.
config.controller.layout.tooltip: Auto detects the controller when possible and otherwise falls back to Xbox labels. Override this only if the displayed button labels are wrong.
config.controller.mapping.tooltip: Auto is recommended. Standard uses XInput physical positions. Nintendo Native is a compatibility override for drivers that report the printed Nintendo A/B/X/Y labels directly.
mimi.social.introduction: So we're officially acquainted now. Try not to make it sound too respectable.
mimi.social.mon: I had three plans for today. ChaCha ate one of them. Don't ask how.
mimi.social.tue: People keep calling this a job. I prefer 'profitable wandering'.
mimi.social.wed: If I look busy, I'm probably avoiding something even busier.
mimi.social.thu: You know, cardboard has remarkable emotional range. Mostly disappointment.
mimi.social.fri: Friday already? Good. I was running out of convincing excuses.
mimi.social.sat: No shop today. Even mysterious merchants need to disappear professionally.
mimi.social.sun: Wizard says I should rest. I am resting very aggressively.
mimi.social.rain: Rain is excellent for staying indoors and pretending that was the plan all along.
mimi.social.birthday: You remembered Spring 17? ...I was absolutely going to remember yours too. Probably.$h
mimi.gift.love: Oh... that's actually perfect. Don't look so pleased with yourself.$h
mimi.gift.like: Useful, strange, or shiny. You are learning my highly scientific standards.$h
mimi.gift.neutral: Thanks. I'll put it somewhere ChaCha can't immediately investigate.
mimi.gift.dislike: Ah. A gift. Definitely a gift. I can confirm that much.$s
mimi.gift.hate: I have questions. Most of them begin with 'why'.$a
mimi.attic.locked: MiMi's attic is upstairs. She has somehow made it clear that you need {{hearts}} hearts before 'accidentally' wandering in.
mimi.attic.unavailable: The attic stairs seem to be arguing with reality right now. Try again after re-entering the Wizard's house.
mimi.attic.inspect.desk: MiMi’s desk is covered in arrows, warnings, Cardboard Scrap bookmarks, and one rule: “Do NOT let ChaCha choose the calibration target.”
mimi.attic.inspect.tv: The remote is still warm. Snacks, a romance-drama schedule, and suspiciously detailed character pairings are tucked beside it.
mimi.attic.inspect.chacha: ChaCha’s cushion has tiny brackets, a Magic Dust jar, and three adjustment knobs. Comfort apparently has a research budget.
